subject: Re: A club idea
text:
Hi,

Thanks for the helpful suggestion last week about the photography club outing. It gave me the idea to invite a friend to join us on Saturday, if that still sounds okay. I thought it would be easier for someone new to come with me rather than arrive alone. The walk starts near the old market, then we meet for coffee at the library cafe. No pressure at all, and we can leave early if plans change. I would just appreciate a quick reply so I know how many seats to expect. If it works, I can send the short address again and the meeting time tomorrow.
